items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I met him in Chicago when I was up there

ctx.x: And the rest of the bands would play the stops behind you like they do today?

Well, sometimes, yeah, they'd play the stop, or either sometimes they'd just play the straight rhythm and use solo, because, like I said, on the boat, a banjo player had to be a solo. Because they had one guy named Red, and they had one guy named Roberson. I met him in Chicago when I was up there, and those guys were terrific banjo players.
Who did you say was about the best banjo player going when you were a young kid?
